description: 기상청 항공기상청_공항기상관측자료 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청 항공기상청. 항공기상청에서 운영하는 공항 기상 관측 지점에서 관측한 매 분 기상관측 자료, 매 정시 관측 통계값, 일별 통계값을 제공합니다. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
